messages:
oncall-scheduler: Quick handoff check for the night shift (primary/secondary + runbook pointers). Primary tonight: @alice, secondary: @bob. Please confirm coverage and flag any expected gaps. Link to runbooks: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/production-oncall and https://redwood.internal/runbooks/model-fallbacks :spiral_calendar_pad:

alice: I'm on primary until 08:00 PDT tomorrow. I'll be reachable on Slack and phone (alice-mobile). I've got the usual check list: infra dashboard, model-serving metrics, error budgets.

bob: Confirming secondary. I'll take pages if Alice doesn't ack within 2m. I'm on-call until 04:00 PDT.

charlie: Heads up — I'm OOO from 22:00-02:00 but available for consult if needed (pager escalation only). There's a known low-capacity window on cluster-west around 00:30 due to maintenance job; it's expected but may increase latency.

dana: Not on tonight but leaving a couple quick pointers in case the incident is the usual suspects:
- If you see token latency spike + 5xxs, first check the GPU host saturation: https://redwood.internal/infra/hosts (filter by region).
- For model OOMs, trigger fallback to quantized-variant via the routing console or run:
```bash
redwoodctl route update --service text-gen --fallback model=textgen-v1-quant --commit
```
- If KV cache is corrupted (rare), bounce the runtime process on affected node: `systemctl restart redwood-runtime` and watch `journalctl -u redwood-runtime -f` for warm-up messages.

incident-bot: [Paging] alice was paged for incident INC-20240312-847 while primary. Escalation policy: 2m to secondary, 10m to oncall-lead.

alice: Acknowledge pager. Investigating error spike on /v1/generate — seeing elevated 502s from model-proxy. First triage: check proxy logs, then confirm if model host reached 100% mem.

bob: If proxy logs show repeated connection resets, try increasing proxy worker pool temporarily:
```yaml
# proxy-config snippet
workers: 32  # default 16, bump to 32 for short window
max_conn: 4096
```
Apply with `kubectl -n inference apply -f proxy-config.yaml` and monitor request latency.

alice: Did the config bump; latency improved but errors persist for some sessions. Looks like a small set of requests are triggering runaway token loops. I'm throttling by route for suspicious clients: `ratelimit set --route /v1/generate --qps 5`.

charlie: Useful quick-runbook link for loops: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/loops-and-stalls — lists how to identify prompt patterns, blacklist, and apply per-customer rate-limits. Also reminder: preserve logs for 72h before trimming.

dana: If customer impact is >1% error rate for 5m, mark as P1 and run the customer impact template: https://redwood.internal/incidents/customer-impact-template.md — populate affected tenant IDs and ETA for mitigation.

oncall-scheduler: Noted. Who is documenting the timeline for postmortem?

alice: I'll keep a short timeline in the incident doc (linking here) and hand it off to @charlie for deeper follow-up since he saw the maintenance window. Doc: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-20240312-847 (created).

bob: One more quick pointer: if model fallback causes quality regressions, use `routing revert` to go back to v1-main while we triage quantized variant: `redwoodctl route revert --service text-gen --to v1-main`

alice: Thanks — setting follow-up reminders. Also leaving a concise runbook excerpt here for the night shift in case the primary gets paged again:
1) Verify page -> check proxy logs and host metrics
2) If host saturated -> consider short-term routing to alternate region or start reserved burst pool (`redwoodctl capacity burst --region us-west-2 --pool reserved-night`)
3) If repeated 5xx from specific tenant -> apply per-tenant throttle and open a ticket to account team
4) If KV cache issue -> restart runtime on affected nodes and monitor for cache warm hits >80%

bob: Confirmed. If any coverage gaps appear (e.g., overlap missing 02:00-03:00), ping #eng-sre for secondary coverage.

oncall-scheduler: Thanks all. I'll update the schedule to reflect Charlie's consult window and Dana's pointers. If anyone takes over primary before end of shift, please update the oncall calendar and ping me. Good luck and ping here if pages escalate. :thumbsup:
